messages:
Jin: Hi all, day 2 here. Trying to create an incident postmortem page from the official template but I can't find where templates are stored in Notion anymore. The old repo link is 404. Any pointers?
Harper: Welcome Jin! :wave: The canonical templates moved to Knowledge -> Docs Templates last quarter. If you can't see it, likely a permissions thing.
Jin: I can see Knowledge but no "Docs Templates" subpage. Is there a direct link I can try?
DocsBot: Quick link: https://notion.redwood.internal/knowledge/docs-templates. If you get a 403, open the Request Docs Access form and include that URL.
Jin: Thanks. I tried the link and got 403. Filed the form but curious about workflow: should I duplicate the postmortem template into my team space or edit the canonical one?
Harper: Duplicate into Team Space for drafts (three-dot menu -> Duplicate). For changes to canonical templates, request edit rights and propose changes via comments so owners can review.
Elena: I own the incident postmortem template. Ping me and I'll add you as an editor if it's urgent. Otherwise, open a comment on the template with your suggested tweaks and tag me.
Jin: Great, pinging now @Elena. Also, are there required front-matter properties for postmortems?
Harper: Yes: Incident ID, Severity, Owner, Detection time, Mitigation summary, RCA summary, and Impact metrics. We have a checklist block in the template that enforces those fields.
Jin: One more: any naming rules for copies so search works? I don't want to create duplicates.
Elena: Use: "Team / Incident - PM - YYYY-MM-DD - ShortTitle". Add property IncidentID and tag with the service name. Also set Lifecycle to draft until reviewed.
IT Helpdesk: FYI if your SSO groups are wrong, send a ticket with your employee ID and the page URL and we'll sync group memberships.
Jin: Filed the access form and opened a ticket with IT. Thanks everyone for the quick help!
Harper: Welcome aboard Jin. If you want, we can do a 10m screenshare to show the template fields and watchers settings.
Jin: Would love that, scheduling now. Thanks :smile:
